_doc: Sourced general guidance that replaces 'unknown' values. scope=general means category guidance (AHA / moisturiser), NOT a tested claim about this product. UI must show the source label.

aad_products.name: American Academy of Dermatology — Get the most from skin care products

aad_dry.name: American Academy of Dermatology — Tips to relieve dry skin

suitable_skin_types.text: AHA exfoliant. If your skin is sensitive, start with one new product at a time. Stop if it stings, burns or tingles.

active_strength.text: Strength is not on the label. Reference: AHA cosmetics are considered safe at 10% or less, pH 3.5 or higher, with daily sun protection.

patch_test_note.text: Patch test: apply a small amount to the inner forearm twice a day for 4–5 days. No redness or itching? Then use it on your face.

sun_protection.text: AHAs can make skin more likely to sunburn. Use sunscreen daily while you use it and for 1 week after you stop.

expected_timeline.text: Most treatment products need at least 6 weeks to show results, sometimes up to 3 months.

suitable_skin_types.text: Dry skin: a cream holds more moisture than a lotion. Sensitive skin: choose fragrance-free products.

patch_test_note.text: Patch test: apply a small amount to the inner forearm twice a day for 4–5 days before using it on your face.

how_to_apply.text: Apply while skin is still damp, for example right after washing.

expected_timeline.text: A moisturiser can make fine lines look smoother within a few days.

suitable_skin_types.text: Contains an AHA exfoliant. If your skin is sensitive, add the serum slowly. Stop if it stings, burns or tingles.

active_strength.text: Serum strength is not on the label. Reference: AHA cosmetics are considered safe at 10% or less, pH 3.5 or higher, with daily sun protection.

patch_test_note.text: Patch test each product: inner forearm, twice a day for 4–5 days, before facial use.

sun_protection.text: The AHA serum can make skin more likely to sunburn. Use sunscreen daily, and for 1 week after you stop.

expected_timeline.text: Moisturiser: smoother-looking skin within days. AHA serum: usually at least 6 weeks, up to 3 months.
